title: Two-layer MLP: forward and backward by hand
hints: Forward: h_pre = X @ W1 + b1, h = max(h_pre, 0), logits = h @ W2 + b2. Keep X, h_pre and h in the cache; backward needs them.
Start the backward pass from d(loss)/d(logits) = (softmax(logits) - onehot(y)) / N. For a linear layer out = inp @ W + b: dW = inp.T @ dout, db = dout.sum(axis=0), dinp = dout @ W.T.
ReLU's derivative is the mask (h_pre > 0), so dh_pre = dh * (h_pre > 0). Then apply the linear-layer rule again with X as the input to get dW1 and db1.
